For a 5-day absence, you are required to provide self-certification, and you must notify your manager on the same day of your absence [HR-203_sick_leave_emea.md::structure_aware::6]. 

Regarding the carry-over rule for sick leave, it is stated that sick leave does not carry over between calendar years and has no cash-out value upon termination. Unused sick days are forfeited on December 31st with no exceptions [HR-203_sick_leave_emea.md::structure_aware::8].
